Bilingual Sales Representative – Spanish & English

Arete Pest Control

Países permitidosLATAM, México
Modalidad100% Remote (Home Office)
Idioma requeridoInglés y Español
ExperienciaMinimum 1 year of direct sales and closing experience
SalarioCompetitive (sales-focused)
HorarioFull-time (US Business Hours)
Tipo de contrataciónFull-time, Permanent
Fecha de publicación2026-11-28 (Límite: 2026-12-28)

Descripción del puesto

Full-time remote bilingual sales role handling inbound and outbound calls, qualifying leads, overcoming objections, and closing deals during US business hours.

Funciones principales

  • Handle inbound and outbound sales calls in Spanish and English.
  • Qualify leads, explain services and pricing, handle objections, and close deals.
  • Follow up consistently with unclosed leads and upsell/cross-sell when appropriate.
  • Maintain accurate notes and pipeline activity in the CRM.

Requisitos

  • Fluent or near-native Spanish and strong spoken/written English.
  • Minimum 1 year of direct sales experience with proven closing results and KPIs.
  • Reliable computer, internet connection, and availability during US business hours.

Beneficios

  • 100% remote long-term, permanent full-time position.
  • Work with an established US-based company.
